summary: I re-tested the fixes to the App Health page from iteration 130 on the live preview, and all 6 items pass. (1) Route privacy: I sent 30 calls to /api/rf/friends/code/QAZWSXED with a Rapid Fire grant (they got 404, then 429 once the per-player limit kicked in) and 30 without one (all 401). The route list shows '/api/rf/friends/code/{code}' and '/api/rf/friends/code/{id}'. QAZWSXED does not appear anywhere in the /health/data JSON, nor in any route key of any rf_health_nodes document (I checked every key, not just the top 15). The patterns '/api/rf/duels/{did}/answer' and '/api/rf/sessions/{sid}' show up, and '/api/jl/auth/me' stays as it is. (2) Cup Night: I read the data 7 times, 2 s apart. late_s was between 1 and 3 every time (limit is 6) and last_s_ago was present. In the browser, 6 more samples gave class 'num g' (green) every time. Labels: Warm-up after start, Closing old matches, Question bank check, Database setup (each release). Closing old matches was green ('59 s ago') after the restart. (3) After `supervisorctl restart backend` and a 9 s wait, copies has length 1, the old copy's rf_health_nodes row is gone, and the Server copies tile shows 1. (4) Sign out: I inserted a scratch jl_jars row and an rf_trust row (_id = sha256('sid:'+sid)) and sent POST /api/jl/auth/logout with X-JL-Sid and a JSON body. It returned 200 and both rows were deleted. With no body the website answers 415, and the rows are kept as expected. The app's own sign-out sends {}. (5) Page at 390 and 1920: every td.num has nowrap and none wrap. 'Refresh now' and 'Sign out' are on one line (44 px tall). 'Updated … · Signed in as qa***@test' shows. Every .wrap table fits with no sideways scroll (scrollWidth == clientWidth) and the page has no sideways overflow. Route cells contain the zero-width break after each '/'. With an intercepted empty-lists response, the 4 empty-state rows show the right text and colspans. Refresh changes the time. Sign out shows the login form and data then returns 401. With no cookie the login form shows. (6) test_phase3_engine.py: 16 of 16 pass. test_phase3_live_regression.py: 24 of 24 pass. App smoke at 390x844: the QA learner signs in, the Rapid Fire lobby loads (profile 200, coins and diamonds shown, rf/access 200), and a Physics solo sprint starts (POST rf/sessions 200, saved with the real learner as user_id). I answered 4 cards and the screen moved to card 5 of 30. The only failed call was the expected one 401 on jl/auth/refresh at first load. No new defects. One small cosmetic note on the page.

critical_code_review_comments: RouteStats depends on the router writing scope['route'] into the same scope dict that RFAccessGuard now changes in place. This works today. Any future middleware that copies the scope (for example dict(scope)) would quietly bring raw addresses back for routed calls. Only the fallback route_of() folding would then protect codes, and it misses lower-case-only codes. Worth a comment or test that keeps this in place (test_phase3_engine covers part of it).
Jobs read from rf_meta (sweep, database_setup) use seen=now, so their late_s equals last_s_ago. That is fine for the 330 s sweep threshold but not the same meaning as for per-copy jobs.
Owner-page Sign out hides the panel but leaves the old table contents in the DOM (hidden). Harmless.
